bibl.title: Archetypes and Antigrapha in the Papyrological Documentation: Preliminary Considerations.
bibl.seg: Giuditta Mirizio, Archetypes and Antigrapha in the Papyrological Documentation: Preliminary Considerations.
bibl.note: Examines a particular pattern of communication, employed for the exchange of information between the offices of Ptolemaic Egypt: the "cascade-letters". - 1. The model and its surroundings. - 2. Multiplication of documents. [Refers in part. to P. Tebt. III, 703, lines 245-257.] - 3. Reuse of files.
